name: multi-select-complementary

manifest.title: Release cut runs through cargo-release on a rel- branch
manifest.description: Matters when cutting a release: cargo-release refuses detached HEAD, so create a rel-<version> branch first, then push commit and tag manually.

manifest.title: Release tag push must NOT re-publish registries
manifest.description: Matters when re-running any release workflow: dispatching with release_tag set skips registry publish; pushing a duplicate tag version to crates.io fails the whole job.

manifest.title: Console dark theme uses tokens.css
manifest.description: Matters when changing console styling: colors come from tokens.css variables, never inline hex.

turn_text: Cut the next release of the crate and make sure the registries end up correct.
notes: Complementary multi-select: the procedure AND the gotcha are both load-bearing for a correct release; under-selection (picking only one) is the failure mode this guards.
